description: This file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractCommandStrategy' in Java for a command handling framework within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides a template for specific command strategies by handling common logic such as validation, logging, and metadata calculation, and declares abstract methods for subclasses to implement specific behavior.

classes.name: AbstractCommandStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the CommandStrategy interface, providing a common template for command handling logic including class matching, application, and validation.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Performs validation and decides whether to handle or reject the command, logging the process and invoking doApply or unhandled accordingly.

methods.name: calculateRelativeMetadata
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to implement specific calculation of metadata based on the entity and command.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to implement the actual application logic of the command.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Throws an IllegalArgumentException indicating the command was unhandled by this strategy.

methods.name: getMatchingClass
methods.description: Returns the class of command this strategy handles.

methods.name: getEntityOrThrow
methods.description: Utility method to ensure the entity is non-null, throwing if null.

methods.name: getEventTimestamp
methods.description: Utility method to get the current timestamp.
